cs.t: I've had cheap (~$100) burr grinders and still got too much dust in my ground for a proper-tasting espresso.  Bought a Nuova Simonelli MCF (back when they were $350 instead of $600) and the commercial-level burrs and worm-gear infinite grind adjustment made my espresso incredibly better.  Details on features of a grinder like this:  https://www.seattlecoffeegear.com/nuova-simonelli-mcf
cs.th: How tinkerers brought PID temp control to espresso machines
